faq.q: Can I buy just one side of a duplex in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: Only if that side is legally separate — a strata lot in a 2-lot strata plan, or its own fee-simple lot from a subdivision. Check the title first.

faq.q: Is there any 55+ ownership I can buy in Citadel?
faq.a: Citadel = zero known 55+ ownership; the city's one 55+ strata is Mayfair Terrace in Central Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: When are property taxes due in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: For 2026, City of Port Coquitlam property taxes were due July 2, 2026; a 5% penalty applies to current taxes unpaid after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% to taxes outstanding after September 15, 2026, under Annual Tax Rates Bylaw, 2026, No. 4441.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 137 houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 19 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 14%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The October report gave $1,250,000 for houses in Port Coquitlam, against $1,262,500 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The October report showed 21 days on market for houses in Port Coquitlam and a sale-to-list price ratio of 94%, against 42 days the month before.
